titleEn: Find Original Array From Doubled Array
title: 从双倍数组中还原原数组
summary: changed 由原数组与每个元素的两倍混合而成，返回任一原数组，不可能则返回空数组。
insight: 元素非负，升序处理能确保先匹配较小原数与其两倍。频次中当前值仍有剩余时必须消耗一个当前值和一个 2*value。
pitfalls: 按升序避免把双倍值误作原值

solutions.title: 升序频次配对
solutions.idea: 依次把最小未使用元素认作原数并消耗双倍值。
steps: 奇数长度返回空；排序 changed 并统计频次
遍历 value，频次零跳过；若 frequency[2value]==0 返回空
两频次各减一，value 加入答案；完成返回

code.java: class Solution { public int[] findOriginalArray(int[] changed){if(changed.length%2==1)return new int[0];Arrays.sort(changed);Map<Integer,Integer> frequency=new HashMap<>();for(int value:changed)frequency.merge(value,1,Integer::sum);int[] answer=new int[changed.length/2];int index=0;for(int value:changed)if(frequency.get(value)>0){if(frequency.getOrDefault(value*2,0)==0)return new int[0];frequency.put(value,frequency.get(value)-1);frequency.put(value*2,frequency.get(value*2)-1);answer[index++]=value;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findOriginalArray(changed:IntArray):IntArray{if(changed.size%2==1)return intArrayOf();changed.sort();val frequency=HashMap<Int,Int>();for(value in changed)frequency[value]=(frequency[value]?:0)+1;val answer=IntArray(changed.size/2);var index=0;for(value in changed)if((frequency[value]?:0)>0){if((frequency[value*2]?:0)==0)return intArrayOf();frequency[value]=frequency[value]!!-1;frequency[value*2]=frequency[value*2]!!-1;answer[index++]=value};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> findOriginalArray(vector<int>& changed){if(changed.size()%2)return{};sort(changed.begin(),changed.end());unordered_map<int,int> frequency;for(int value:changed)++frequency[value];vector<int> answer;for(int value:changed)if(frequency[value]){if(!frequency[value*2])return{};--frequency[value];--frequency[value*2];answer.push_back(value);}return answer;} };
